name: Infomarchy
author: Fred Nix & Larry
description: Your wallpaper becomes a live, clickable information desk: every running AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini, opencode, Ollama), a 7-day activity heatmap, subscription limits, recent prompts, and a machine-stats corner (CPU, RAM, disk, Wi-Fi speed, Cloudflare latency, GPU, battery). Theme-driven. SUPER+D overlay.
